items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta and Edward "Kid" Ory Interview, 1958-08-26
items.q: So I plays there with him until about eleven o'clock. ... And I plays there with him in the girls' place.

ctx.x: I'll go and test them out. That's all right. Let's be starting a visit. Don't worry about it.

So, after grand opening that night, so what I does, Poison says, I go to the airport and meet him at seven o'clock. He says, well we got a lot of time. I says, let's go around. I say, your band is open for the Dream Line. I say, yeah. I say, let's go around. We went around and there's a packing jam. I think on Big Zack Show, the Bremier of the Bandstand. It was so packed. He was sticking with us. He said, get out the way. They all get out the way. He said, just say, please. Same band, we left with him just like…
years ago. What year was that? Four years was the hanging room.
